representation: Parabola with a fixed current point, its tangent, a horizontal step arrow, and the projected next point.
motion: The learning-rate slider changes the leftward step length and the next point on the curve.
checkpoints: small rate stays short of the minimum
rate 1.2 overshoots and raises the cost
misconceptionTest: The gradient points uphill to the right; the step goes left. A larger rate can overshoot rather than always improve.
accessibility: Alt text, keyboard-operable slider, direction shown by an arrow and text, reduced-motion support.
